opportunities.name: Marked attack filler
opportunities.objective: Test one real attack between shadow abilities and Death Mark expiry.
opportunities.mechanic: R records a three-second damage window; Q/shadows supply physical hits and W returns energy when matching abilities hit. Trinity supports one actual post-cast attack, BotRK adds a current-health packet and passive adds conditional magic damage below half health. The mark repeat must be logged without assuming every proc counts.
opportunities.requiredState: R mark active, finite energy, target below half for passive and Spellblade ready.
opportunities.failure: The attack delays a multi-shuriken hit or exposes Zed before escape.
opportunities.test: Compare R-Q-E versus the same sequence plus one attack, isolating passive/item and final mark packets.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: W shadow Q casts do not themselves consume attack Spellblade.

opportunities.name: Slash-driven shadow recycle
opportunities.objective: Use actual Zed E champion contact to shorten W and produce a second escape/attack angle.
opportunities.mechanic: E by Zed reduces W cooldown three seconds per champion hit; shadow E adds slow but overlapping slashes deal no extra damage. Shojin haste and physical Cleaver pressure test a longer exchange, with Eclipse and Deaths Dance supporting survival. E contact and W energy refund must be earned, not assumed from every shadow.
opportunities.requiredState: Record energy and W state; Zed own E reaches one or more champions safely.
opportunities.failure: Only the shadow reaches the target, so the planned W cooldown reduction fails.
opportunities.test: Log W timer after Zed E versus shadow-only E and count energy refunds for matched Q hits.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Overlapping E slashes do not each deal full damage or each independently grant the own-E W refund.

ruledOut.reason: Passive retained percent-health magic damage is conditional/unresolved, with no documented AP ratio to support an AP Zed kit claim.

unknowns: Passive GameCalculationConditional is unresolved; Death Mark item/pet damage ledger and AD statFormula=2 need live reconciliation. No mana pools on Energy.

builds.name: Marked attack filler
builds.summary: Test one real attack between shadow abilities and Death Mark expiry.
builds.goal: Test one real attack between shadow abilities and Death Mark expiry.
builds.hypothesis: R records a three-second damage window; Q/shadows supply physical hits and W returns energy when matching abilities hit. Trinity supports one actual post-cast attack, BotRK adds a current-health packet and passive adds conditional magic damage below half health. The mark repeat must be logged without assuming every proc counts.
testPlan: Required state: R mark active, finite energy, target below half for passive and Spellblade ready.
Compare R-Q-E versus the same sequence plus one attack, isolating passive/item and final mark packets.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: The attack delays a multi-shuriken hit or exposes Zed before escape.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: W shadow Q casts do not themselves consume attack Spellblade.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Trinity Force, Blade of The Ruined King, Serylda's Grudge, Edge of Night, Guardian Angel, Ionian Boots of Lucidity. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

Zed becomes Untargetable and dashes to an enemy champion, marking them. After [3] seconds, the mark triggers, dealing [(1) × AD] physical damage and repeating [(0.25 / 0.4 / 0.55) × 100]% of all damage dealt to the target by Zed while the mark was active.

The dash leaves a Shadow behind for [7.5] seconds. Zed can Recast this Ability to switch positions with this Shadow.

Zed and his Shadows throw their shurikens, each dealing [80 / 120 / 160 / 200 / 240 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage to the first enemy they pass through, and [(80 / 120 / 160 / 200 / 240 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2]) × (0.6)] physical damage to each additional enemy.

kitEvidence.formula:
Passive: Zed gains [30 / 35 / 40 / 45 / 50] Energy whenever he and his Shadows strike an enemy with the same Ability.

Active: Zed's Shadow dashes forward, remaining in place for [5] seconds. Recasting this Ability will cause Zed to switch positions with this Shadow.

Zed and his Shadows throw their shurikens, each dealing [80 / 120 / 160 / 200 / 240 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage to the first enemy they pass through, and [(80 / 120 / 160 / 200 / 240 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2]) × (0.6)] physical damage to each additional enemy.

Zed and his Shadows slash, dealing [70 / 92.5 / 115 / 137.5 / 160 + (0.7) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage to nearby enemies.

Each enemy champion hit by Zed's slash reduces Living Shadow's Cooldown by [3] seconds.

Enemies hit by a Shadow's slash are Slowed by [(-0.2 / -0.25 / -0.3 / -0.35 / -0.4) × -100]% for [1.5] seconds. Enemies hit by multiple slashes take no additional damage but are Slowed by [(-0.3 / -0.375 / -0.45 / -0.525 / -0.6) × -100]% instead.
